name: dish-tabbouleh-season
subject: Tabbouleh of finely chopped parsley topped with diced tomato, on lettuce leaves with lemon slices, in a white bowl on weathered wood; spoons of paprika and dried herbs behind
altEn: Parsley tabbouleh crowned with diced tomato and lemon slices, on lettuce leaves on a wooden table
altAr: تبولةُ بقدونسٍ مفروم تعلوها مكعّباتُ الطماطم وشرائحُ الليمون، على أوراق خسٍّ فوق طاولةٍ خشبية
notes: Unsplash, Chez Le Libanais. Even soft light; warm wood. 4:5 crop centred on the bowl drops the spice spoons top-right.

name: dish-hassawi-kabsa
subject: Top-down: long-grain spiced rice with a whole roasted, turmeric-yellow meat piece in a large silver tray on dark stone; small bowls of broth, red daqqus sauce and tea; brass spoons, terracotta linen; a bowl of luqaimat top-left
altEn: Spiced rice topped with roasted meat in a silver tray, with small bowls of broth and red tomato sauce
altAr: أرزٌّ متبّل تعلوه قطعةُ لحمٍ مشويّة في صينيةٍ فضية، وحولها أوعيةُ مرقٍ وصلصةِ دقّوس
notes: Unsplash, aboodi vesakaran. Gulf-style mandi/kabsa styling (tray, daqqus, brass); rice is pale, not the red Hassawi rice, and the meat reads as chicken/lamb - acceptable stand-in. Crop 4:5 centred on tray.

name: dish-eggs-east-wall
subject: Top-down: three sunny-side-up eggs in a black speckled cast pan on a white gas hob
altEn: Three sunny-side-up eggs with deep orange yolks in a black pan
altAr: ثلاثُ بيضاتٍ مقليّة بصفارٍ برتقاليٍّ عميق في مقلاةٍ سوداء
notes: Unsplash, Hasan Almasi. No tomato/sausage visible - plain fried eggs stand-in; hob is cool white, grade warm and crop tight to the pan (4:5 inside the pan rim). Rejected a skillet frame with a breakfast sausage patty (possible pork).

name: dish-akkawi-manakish
subject: Top-down: round white-cheese flatbread cut into eight wedges with flecks of green herb, on a round wooden board over dark slate, woven mat and jute rope to the right
altEn: Round cheese flatbread cut into wedges on a wooden board
altAr: خبزٌ مستدير بالجبن الأبيض مقطّعٌ أثلاثًا على لوحٍ خشبي
notes: Unsplash, Husien Bisky. Cheese manakish stand-in (herb flecks, no visible nigella). Crop 4:5 on the board, dropping the faux plant top-right and the potted plant bottom-left.

name: dish-tamees-foul
subject: Beans simmering in a red, cumin-and-pepper-flecked sauce in a battered pot over an open fire; a flatbread toasting on the griddle behind, steam rising
altEn: Beans simmering in a spiced tomato sauce in a blackened pot, flatbread toasting on the griddle behind
altAr: فولٌ يغلي في صلصةٍ متبّلة داخل قدرٍ مسودٍّ من النار، وخلفه رغيفٌ يتحمّص على الصاج
notes: Unsplash, P.O.sitive Negative. Rustic fire-side foul; filmic warm-muted grade. Beans are rounder/redder than classic Hijazi foul - plausible stand-in. Keep the pot in the lower half of a 4:5 crop.

name: dish-mutabbaq
subject: Close-up of a griddled stuffed bread cut open, showing a filling of egg, greens and chicken, against a dark background
altEn: A griddled stuffed pastry cut open to show egg and greens inside
altAr: فطيرةٌ محمّرة على الصاج مقطوعةٌ تكشف حشوةً من البيض والخضرة
notes: Unsplash, Fatemeh Rz. Stand-in: thicker bread than a true layered mutabbaq; reads as a stuffed griddled pastry. Shallow depth of field - keep focus band (y 0.4-0.6) in crop.

name: dish-gahwa-service
subject: Brass dallah with small cups beside a woven palm-frond basket of dates, on a straw mat in front of a sadu-patterned floor cushion
altEn: A brass dallah and small coffee cups beside a woven basket of dates
altAr: دلّةٌ نحاسية وفناجينُ صغيرة بجانب سلّةِ خوصٍ ملأى بالتمر
notes: Unsplash, L Photography. Authentic Gulf props (dallah, khoos basket, sadu). Warm indoor light, slightly flashy - grade down. Crop 4:5 between x 0.05-0.75 to drop the white artificial flowers (bottom-left) and green/yellow object on right edge.

name: dish-fattoush-sumac
subject: Leafy salad with spinach, red-veined sorrel, apple slices, walnuts and pomegranate seeds in a black stoneware bowl on grey marble, in hard low sun with long shadows; small cup of dressing
altEn: Leafy salad with pomegranate seeds and walnuts in a black bowl, under hard sunlight
altAr: سلطةُ أوراقٍ خضراء بحبّات الرمّان والجوز في وعاءٍ أسود تحت شمسٍ حادّة
notes: Unsplash, kimia kazemi. Stand-in for fattoush (no crisp bread or sumac visible) chosen for its hard directional sunlight and long shadow - strongly on-concept. Portrait 2800x4192.
